select fish_date_season as season,
  cls,
  cast(fish_date_doy/20 as int)*20 as doy_bucket,
  count(*) as n,
  sum(yt)/sum(anglers) as ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season = 6 and fish_date_doy >= 150 and cls in ('three_quarter','day_1_5','overnight')
group by 1,2,3
order by 2,3

select fish_date_doy as doy, count(*) as n, sum(yt) as yt, sum(anglers) as anglers, sum(yt)/sum(anglers) as ypa
from trips
where fish_date_season = 6 and cls = 'three_quarter' and fish_date_doy between 170 and 182
group by 1 order by 1
